figures.finding: The state film body, the Institut gabonais de l’image et du son (IGIS), gave financial, material and human support estimated at 100 million FCFA to about fifteen Gabonese filmmakers and actors in 2024; a levy in the Communication Code finances film and audiovisual activity.
